ticket_payload.title: [P0-CRITICAL] CVE-2021-44228 Apache Log4j RCE on 10.0.1.10:8080
ticket_payload.remediation_summary:
1. Upgrade org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core to version >= 2.17.1.
2. Set environment variable LOG4J_FORMAT_MSG_NO_LOOKUPS=true as temporary mitigation.
3. Verify /api/v1/auth endpoint with re-scan after deployment.
